title: fix(clone): clone get times out at 5s on a box where ss is slow
description:
## the gap

on a loaded box where `ss -xp` takes 5s or more, a direct `rhx clone get` always reads `clone get read timed out { replyMs: 5000 }`. its 5s reply bound sits below the peer-cred lookup bound (60s since #678) and the auth gate (65s). each timed-out `get` also leaves its scan to run, up to the 60s bound.

## the shape of the fix

- give `clone get` a reply window that rides the lookup, or a named `auth-in-flight` reply, so the caller can tell a slow gate from a dead clone
- pair with #684 (abort the scan on hangup), so a timed-out `get` frees its scan

## evidence

- found in review of the #678 fix (`.behavior/v2026_11_01.fix-clone-auth-lookup-timeout`, catalog row `.get × same × >= 5s`)
